name: Plant-Parasitic Nematodes
scientificName: Meloidogyne spp. (root-knot) / Pratylenchus spp. (lesion) / Scutellonema spp.
description: Microscopic roundworms that infect plant roots, causing galls, lesions, and reduced root function. They are a major constraint in yam, plantain, banana, and cocoyam production in West Africa, causing significant yield losses.
symptoms: Root galls or knots visible on root system
Root decay and secondary fungal infections
treatments: Apply organic amendments (neem cake, poultry manure) to suppress populations
Use carbofuran or oxamyl for high-value crops in severe infestations
Solarize soil during hot dry season
Apply Trichoderma or Paecilomyces as biocontrol agents
prevention: Practice crop rotation with marigold or cereal crops
Incorporate neem cake into soil before planting
Allow field to fallow with soil solarization
Use clean tools and avoid moving infested soil
